# awscc_cloudhsm_cluster (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudHSM::Cluster



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster.
- `backup_policy` (String) The cluster's backup policy.
- `backup_retention_policy` (Attributes) A policy that defines how the service retains backups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_retention_policy))
- `cluster_id` (String) The cluster's identifier (ID).
- `hsm_type` (String) The type of HSM to use in the cluster.
- `mode` (String) The mode to use in the cluster.
- `network_type` (String) The NetworkType to create a cluster with.
- `security_group` (String) The identifier (ID) of the cluster's security group.
- `state` (String) The cluster's state.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) The identifiers (IDs) of the subnets where the cluster is created. You must specify at least one subnet.
- `subnet_mapping` (Map of String) A map from availability zone to the cluster's subnet in that availability zone.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to apply to the CloudHSM cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `vpc_id` (String) The identifier (ID) of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that contains the cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--backup_retention_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_retention_policy`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of backup retention policy.
- `value` (String) Use a value between 7 - 379.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.
